questions.stem: A newly-wed 22-year-old woman has started taking Mala N as an oral contraceptive. However, on her honeymoon, she forgets to carry the packet and as a result, she misses 4 consecutive days of the tablet and reports to you the next day, on Day 15 of the tablet. What is the next best step?

options.label: A
options.text: Take the 4 missed pills, continue the packet, take the emergency pill and use a condom for the next 7 days

options.label: B
options.text: Take the last pill, continue the remaining hormonal pills, take the emergency pill, use a condom and then discard the iron pills and start a new pack immediately

options.label: C
options.text: Take the last missed pill, continue the packet, take the emergency pill and use a condom for the next 7 days

options.label: D
options.text: Discard the remaining tablets and start a new pack immediately, use the emergency pill and use a condom for 7 days
